sections.heading: C2 — Regulatory signs
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Regulatory signs

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A02
A center lane marked LEFT TURN ONLY is shared by left-turning vehicles from both directions and cannot be used for through travel or passing. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A02
The DO NOT PASS sign is often paired with a yellow pennant marking a no-passing zone. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A03
KEEP RIGHT signs direct traffic to pass on the right side of the island or divider. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A03
A posted speed limit is the maximum lawful speed for that highway stretch under ideal conditions. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A03
Poor conditions may require a speed below the posted maximum for safety. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A03
A NO TURN ON RED sign requires waiting for green before turning at that intersection. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A03
When a lane sign shows alternative directions, travel may follow either indicated arrow. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A03
A lane sign combining a turn arrow with ONLY requires that turn at the intersection, even if the driver entered the lane by mistake. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A03
LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN permits a left turn while requiring a yield to opposing traffic. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A03
A circular green signal does not protect a left turn where the LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN sign is displayed. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R11 | anchor: A03
LEFT TURN YIELD ON FLASHING YELLOW ARROW allows the left turn when that arrow flashes, but requires yielding to opposing traffic. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R12 | anchor: A03
A left turn made under a flashing yellow arrow is unprotected. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R13 | anchor: A03
A RIGHT TURN SIGNAL sign identifies the nearby traffic signal as controlling right turns. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R14 | anchor: A03
An OPPOSING TRAFFIC HAS EXTENDED GREEN sign warns that opposing vehicles may keep moving after the driver's signal turns red. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R15 | anchor: A03
RESERVED PARKING is a regulatory sign identifying spaces for people with disabilities or severely disabled veterans. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R16 | anchor: A03
Vehicles using reserved disability parking must display an authorized registration plate or parking placard. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec04-R17 | anchor: A03
An unauthorized vehicle in reserved disability parking is subject to a fine and towing charges. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0016]
